preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) representing the number of operations.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines starts with an integer t_i (1 ≤ t_i ≤ 3) denoting the operation type.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) and abs(int(line.split()[2])) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if int(line.split()[0]) == 1)
preconditions.description: If t_i = 1, the line contains two integers a_i and x_i (1 ≤ a_i, |x_i| ≤ 10^3) representing the operation parameters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and abs(int(line.split()[1])) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if int(line.split()[0]) == 2)
preconditions.description: If t_i = 2, the line contains a single integer k_i (|k_i| ≤ 10^3) representing the appended value.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if int(line.split()[0]) == 3)
preconditions.description: If t_i = 3, the line contains no additional values.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines() == [str(sum(sequence) / len(sequence)) for sequence in [initial_sequence] + [apply_operation(sequence, op) for op in operations]]
postconditions.description: For each operation, the output line is the average of the sequence after applying the operation, formatted as a string with exactly 6 decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all('0.' <= line <= '999999.999999' for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid floating-point number representing the average, with absolute or relative error ≤ 10^-6.
